title: Radicchio and Speck Risotto
author: Lorenzo
description: Bitter radicchio and smoky speck in a creamy risotto.
steps: Crisp half the speck in a dry pan and set aside for the top.
Soften the onion in half the butter with the rest of the speck, add the rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and let it evaporate, then add the radicchio and stir until it wilts.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16–18 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the rest of the butter and the parmesan. Rest for 2 minutes and serve with the crisp speck.
